_comment: Idempotent settles (webagents gap-closure plan 0.1, 2026-09-26). Read by
python/tests/test_payment_settle_idempotency_w0_billing.py,
typescript/tests/unit/skills/payments-idempotency-w0-billing.test.ts and the
portal's tests/unit/payments/settle-idempotency-fixture-w0-billing.test.ts,
so the header, the body field and the key derivation cannot drift between
the two SDKs and the platform that reads them.
STABLE keys name a settle the skill lifecycle can identify: one lock, one
purpose. A retry of that settle (the HTTP client's own retry, or a second
finalize on the same context, which the Python run loop can produce on its
error paths) derives the same key and is answered the first result; a new
lock or a new purpose never shares one. The invariant this rests on: a lock
is settled for `usage` and for `agent_fee` at most once each, at finalize.
FRESH keys are for a settle nothing can name: an x402 settle by token (no
lock in hand), the legacy `redeem`, or a raw client call that passes none.
The key is minted once per call, so the client's retry loop reuses it,
and two calls are two settles.
PER-CALL keys (wave-0 review finding 5, 2026-09-26) name the tool call a
settle charges for: two per-call settles for one purpose on one lock are
two keys, never one. Read by the same three suites plus
typescript/tests/unit/skills/payments-idempotency-callid-w2pay.test.ts,
python/tests/test_payment_settle_idempotency_callid_w2pay.py and the
portal's tests/unit/payments/settle-idempotency-w2pay.test.ts.
